source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.3.1.3 (PDF 133, printed 130).

blocks.text: Experiment mein ek ya zyada variables ko jaan boojh kar badal kar dekha jata hai ke doosre variable par kya asar hota hai. Yeh tareeqa khaas taur par science aur engineering mein useful hai jahan sahi measurement (naap) ke liye controlled environment (aisi jagah jahan baqi sab cheezein qaboo mein hon) zaroori hota hai.

Misal: Ek teacher jaanna chahta hai ke kya printed (chhape hue) notes dene se students ke exam results behtar hote hain. Woh students ke do groups banata hai: ek ko printed notes milte hain aur doosra sirf lectures par parhta hai. Ek mahine baad dono groups ek hi test dete hain aur teacher results compare kar ke (mila kar) dekhta hai ke notes ka faida hua ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: Data science mein experimental design mein kya hota hai? (MCQ 2) Notes wale experiment mein control group kaunsa hai?
blocks.explanation: (b) data ko systematically (tarteeb aur plan ke saath) jama karna aur analyze karna. Control group woh group hai jo sirf lectures par parhta hai (jise notes nahi mile); fair muqable ke liye dono groups milte julte hone chahiye.

items: Experiment: ek variable badal kar asar dekhna (printed notes banam sirf lectures).
